title: Integral varifolds have integer density ≥ 1 almost everywhere (step B0)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N and V an n-varifold on U (so U is open). If V is integral (IsIntegral V: IsVarifoldOf V M θ for some M, θ with θ(x) ∈ ℕ for H^n-a.e. x ∈ M), then for μ_V-almost every x there is an integer k ≥ 1 such that the n-dimensional density Θ^n(μ_V, x) exists and equals k (HasDensity n μ_V x k).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral V → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (k : ℝ≥0∞)
